decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Application Form, Design and Access Statement,  Drawing Numbers 6238E_MSS_B00_010 01,  09223/A9302-1960-HLM-DR-E100 02, 09223/A9302-1960-HLM-DR-D640, 09223/A3903-1960-HLM-DR-L001 01 received 26/10/11.)and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Other than those shown on the submitted drawings  under this listed building consent/planning permission, there shall be no external alterations to the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Installation of a satellite dish and radio and television antenna (Listed Building Consent).
